observations: Every guest confesses misconduct and donor conflict. These disclosures clarify motive without exonerating anyone. Artie's new job reduces one motive, Dada's warning resolves its wording, but both statements can be evasive. Hugh and Monet currently have strongest financial pressure; no means or timeline identifies the murderer.
